specification: Write a Python library named samplelib exposing mean(values) and unique(values). mean accepts a list of numbers and returns their arithmetic mean, raising ValueError on an empty list. unique accepts a list of hashable values and returns a new list containing the first occurrence of each value in input order. Neither function may mutate the input list. Use only the standard library. No CLI or README is required.
requirements: samplelib.mean returns the arithmetic mean of nonempty numeric lists, including negative and fractional numbers.
samplelib.mean raises ValueError for an empty list.
samplelib.unique removes duplicates while preserving the order of first occurrence, including empty input.
Both functions leave their input list unchanged and use only the standard library.
